mapper.select: SELECT o.id,o.custom_order_no number,o.version,o.requirement_id,o.accepted_quote_id quote_id,o.factory_id,o.buyer_user_id buyer_id, o.order_status state,o.payment_order_id payment_id,o.delivery_mode,o.delivery_address_snapshot address,o.promised_completion_date promised_date, q.custom_goods_amount_fen goods,q.delivery_fee_fen freight,q.total_amount_fen total_fen,o.total_paid_amount_fen paid,o.refunded_amount_fen refunded_fen, o.production_started_at started_at,o.current_delivery_record_id delivery_id,o.acceptance_status acceptance,o.acceptance_deadline_at deadline, o.acceptance_remaining_seconds remaining,o.updated_at,q.valid_until quote_deadline FROM custom_order o JOIN custom_quote q ON q.id=o.accepted_quote_id WHERE o.id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM custom_order o WHERE o.factory_id=#{factory}o.buyer_user_id=#{buyer} AND o.order_status=#{status}

SELECT id,source_requirement_item_id item_id,item_title title,quantity,unit_price_fen, spec_snapshot_json->>'$.dimension' dimension,spec_snapshot_json->>'$.material' material,spec_snapshot_json->>'$.style' style,acceptance_standard FROM custom_order_item WHERE custom_order_id=#{id} ORDER BY sort_no
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO custom_order(id,custom_order_no,requirement_id,accepted_quote_id,buyer_user_id,factory_id,acceptance_status,order_status, custom_goods_original_amount_fen,custom_goods_discount_amount_fen,custom_goods_paid_amount_fen,delivery_fee_paid_fen,total_paid_amount_fen,refunded_amount_fen, delivery_mode,delivery_address_snapshot,promised_completion_date,commission_rate_bps_snapshot,version,created_at,updated_at) SELECT #{id},CONCAT('CO',#{id}),r.id,q.id,r.buyer_user_id,r.factory_id,'not_started','pending_payment',q.custom_goods_amount_fen,0,0,0,0,0, #{mode},#{address},q.promised_completion_date,2000,0,#{at},#{at} FROM custom_requirement r JOIN custom_quote q ON q.requirement_id=r.id WHERE q.id=#{quote}

INSERT INTO payment_channel_suborder(id,payment_order_id,factory_id,factory_wechat_account_id,sub_mchid_snapshot,channel_sub_order_no, custom_order_id,channel_suborder_amount_fen,channel_suborder_status,channel_description,profit_sharing_flag,payment_status,paid_amount_fen,refunded_amount_fen,freeze_alert_status,created_at,updated_at) SELECT #{id},#{payment},f.id,m.id,m.sub_mchid,#{id},o.id,#{total},'pending','定制商品全款',1,'pending',0,0,'none',#{at},#{at} FROM custom_order o JOIN factory_profile f ON f.id=o.factory_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=f.owner_user_id JOIN factory_wechat_merchant_account m ON m.factory_id=f.id WHERE o.id=#{order} AND f.factory_status='active' AND u.user_status='active' AND m.account_status='active' AND m.profit_sharing_status='active'
mapper.select: SELECT s.custom_order_id FROM payment_channel_suborder s JOIN payment_order p ON p.id=s.payment_order_id WHERE p.id=#{payment} AND p.payment_scene='custom_order_full_payment' AND s.rental_order_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_allocation(id,payment_order_id,payment_channel_suborder_id,custom_order_id,rent_allocated_amount_fen,coupon_discount_allocated_fen, deposit_allocated_amount_fen,service_fee_allocated_fen,freight_prepaid_allocated_fen,compensation_allocated_amount_fen,custom_goods_allocated_amount_fen,total_allocated_amount_fen,created_at) SELECT #{id},s.payment_order_id,s.id,o.id,0,0,0,0,q.delivery_fee_fen,0,q.custom_goods_amount_fen,s.paid_amount_fen,#{at} FROM payment_channel_suborder s JOIN custom_order o ON o.id=s.custom_order_id JOIN custom_quote q ON q.id=o.accepted_quote_id WHERE s.id=#{sub} AND o.id=#{order} AND s.payment_order_id=#{payment} AND s.payment_status='success' AND s.paid_amount_fen=q.total_amount_fen AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM payment_allocation a WHERE a.payment_channel_suborder_id=s.id)
mapper.update: UPDATE custom_order SET order_status='paid_waiting_production',payment_order_id=#{payment},custom_goods_paid_amount_fen=#{goods},delivery_fee_paid_fen=#{freight}, total_paid_amount_fen=#{goods}+#{freight},version=version+1,updated_at=#{at} WHERE id=#{id} AND total_paid_amount_fen=0

UPDATE custom_order SET order_status=#{state},production_started_at=IF(#{state}='producing',COALESCE(production_started_at,#{at}),production_started_at), updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.sql: FROM payment_allocation a LEFT JOIN refund_order r ON r.payment_channel_suborder_id=a.payment_channel_suborder_id AND r.refund_status!='cancelled'
mapper.select:
SELECT o.id orderId,
JOIN custom_order o ON o.id=a.custom_order_id AND o.payment_order_id=a.payment_order_id JOIN payment_channel_suborder s ON s.id=a.payment_channel_suborder_id AND s.payment_order_id=o.payment_order_id AND s.custom_order_id=o.id WHERE o.id IN #{id} GROUP BY o.id, a.id
SELECT WHERE a.payment_channel_suborder_id=#{sub} GROUP BY a.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_order(id,refund_no,request_idempotency_key,biz_order_type,biz_order_id,payment_order_id,payment_channel_suborder_id,refund_type,refund_status, pay_channel,channel_transaction_id,channel_out_trade_no,channel_out_refund_no,rent_refund_amount_fen,deposit_refund_amount_fen,service_fee_refund_fen, freight_refund_amount_fen,compensation_refund_amount_fen,custom_goods_refund_amount_fen,refund_amount_fen,refund_reason,requested_by,requested_at,created_at,updated_at,next_attempt_at) SELECT #{id},#{id},#{key},'custom_order',#{order},s.payment_order_id,s.id,#{type},'pending','wechat_pay',s.channel_sub_transaction_id,s.channel_sub_order_no, #{id},0,0,0,#{freight},0,#{goods},#{goods}+#{freight},LEFT(#{reason},255),#{actor},#{at},#{at},#{at},#{at} FROM payment_channel_suborder s WHERE s.id=#{sub} AND s.custom_order_id=#{order} AND s.payment_status='success'
mapper.update: UPDATE custom_order o SET refunded_amount_fen=COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount_fen) FROM refund_order r WHERE r.biz_order_type='custom_order' AND r.biz_order_id=o.id AND r.payment_order_id=o.payment_order_id AND r.refund_status='success'),0),updated_at=#{at},version=version+1 WHERE o.id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT o.id FROM custom_order o JOIN custom_quote q ON q.id=o.accepted_quote_id JOIN payment_order p ON p.id=o.payment_order_id WHERE o.order_status='pending_payment' AND q.valid_until<=#{at} AND (p.payment_status='closed' OR (p.payment_status='success' AND p.paid_at>p.expire_at)) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 100
